topic: How to pick the right AI for each job instead of hunting for one AI that does everything: one rule, then where to start for deep work and writing, spreadsheets, search, non-English work and presentations, based only on what each company documents
audience: Professionals who use one AI chat for everything and wonder whether another tool would do some jobs better
goal: Pick a first tool for each of their five most common jobs, try it on one real task with the prompts given, and keep what works
notes: Anthropic's model docs advise starting with Claude Opus 5.5 if unsure, and using Fable 5.2 for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. [https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview]

Anthropic recommends starting most coding and knowledge tasks with Opus 5.5 as the 'strongest daily driver', moving up to Fable or down to Sonnet 5.5 or Haiku 5.5 as needed. [https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-2]

Anthropic says Opus 5.5 communicates more naturally: clearer writing, the most important information up front, less jargon, and it follows the writing rules you give it. [https://www.anthropic.com/claude-opus-5-5]

Anthropic positions Sonnet 5.5 as strongest at well-scoped everyday tasks and creating polished documents, slides and spreadsheets, while Opus 5.5 is for complex work needing careful judgment. [https://www.anthropic.com/claude-sonnet-5-5]
On the Free plan, Claude's comparison table shows Sonnet and Haiku as available, but not Opus or Fable; Opus is available on Pro, Max and Ultra. [https://claude.com/pricing]

To change the model in Claude, click the model name next to the send button and pick a model, or click 'More models'. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8664678-change-the-model-effort-and-thinking-settings]
In Claude chat on paid plans, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 have 1M-token context windows. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8606394-how-large-is-the-context-window-on-paid-claude-plans]
ChatGPT's published context windows are 27K (Free), 54K (Go, Plus) and 128K (Pro) for GPT Instant, and 256K (Go, Plus) or 400K (Pro) for GPT Reasoning. [https://chatgpt.com/pricing/]

Claude Projects are self-contained workspaces with their own chat histories and knowledge bases; available to all users, and Free users can create up to five. To create one, go to claude.ai/projects and click '+ New Project'; add files with '+' and instructions with 'Set project instructions'. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9517075-what-are-projects]

Claude can upload PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT, HTML, ODT, RTF, EPUB, JSON and XLSX documents; up to 20 files per chat and PDFs up to 1000 pages. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8241126-upload-files-to-claude]

Anthropic says Claude can hallucinate incorrect or misleading information; don't rely on it as a single source of truth, scrutinize high-stakes advice and check cited sources. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8525154-claude-is-providing-incorrect-or-misleading-responses-what-s-going-on]

Claude does not generate photos or illustrations like image-generation tools; it builds diagrams, charts and interactive visuals, and can analyze images you upload. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9002504-can-claude-produce-images]
ChatGPT's plan table lists image generation on every plan (Limited on Free). [https://chatgpt.com/pricing/]
In the Gemini app, the Nano Banana 2 image model (generation and editing, 2K resolution) is free. [https://gemini.google/overview/image-generation/]
Claude for Microsoft 365 works inside Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook, and claude.com says these are generally available on all paid Claude plans. [https://claude.com/claude-for-microsoft-365]

Claude for Excel answers questions about workbooks with cell-level citations, adjusts assumptions while keeping formulas intact, debugs errors and builds models; it runs on Excel on the web, Windows and Mac. [https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/excel]
The add-ins are installed from the 'Claude for Microsoft 365' listing on Microsoft AppSource ('Get it now'), then you sign in with your Claude account. [https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/excel]

Claude can create Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Word (.docx) and PDF files in a conversation; you can download them or save them directly to Google Drive. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12111783-create-and-edit-files-with-claude]

ChatGPT data analysis accepts spreadsheets (.xls, .xlsx, .csv), PDFs and text/data files, and for some tasks writes and runs Python. Interactive charts are supported for bar, line, pie and scatter charts; to see the numbers, open Chart options (•••) and select View as table. The analysis environment cannot make external web requests. [https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8437071-data-analysis-with-chatgpt]
Data analysis is Limited on ChatGPT Free and included on Go, Plus and Pro; interactive tables and charts are on Plus and Pro only; Search is on every plan. [https://chatgpt.com/pricing/]
For businesses, Gemini with Google Workspace starts at $14 USD per seat per month, with AI built into Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides and more. [https://gemini.google/subscriptions/]

Perplexity Free gives practically unlimited basic searches, 3 Pro Searches a day, 1 Research query a month and limited file uploads, with no advanced AI models or image generation. [https://www.perplexity.ai/help-center/en/articles/11187416-which-perplexity-subscription-plan-is-right-for-you]

Perplexity Pro includes advanced models such as GPT-6.2 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Gemini 4 Neon, and 10x as many citations per answer. [https://www.perplexity.ai/help-center/en/articles/10352901-what-is-perplexity-pro]

Claude web search is enabled in a chat with '+' > 'Web search' and returns answers with citations; in the new Claude experience there is no toggle and Claude searches when it helps. Free accounts can use it. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10684626-enable-and-use-web-search]

Claude Research (paid plans) runs multiple searches that build on each other across the web and connected tools; it is turned on with '+' > 'Research'. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11088861-use-research-on-claude]

Anthropic's guidance: web search suits factual queries needing one or two tool calls; Research suits information gathering needing five or more tool calls over 1-3 minutes. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11095361-when-should-i-use-web-search-extended-thinking-and-research]

To attach a file in Claude, click the '+' button in the message box and select 'Add files or photos'; connectors are reached from '+' > 'Connectors'. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8241126-upload-files-to-claude]

Gemini Free costs $0 a month with a Google Account and includes Deep Research, Canvas and Gemini Notebook. Google says Deep Research can analyze hundreds of sources in real time to write research reports. [https://gemini.google/subscriptions/]
Models may not know about events after their training cutoff. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8114494-how-up-to-date-is-claude-s-training-data]

Anthropic's multilingual docs say Claude is capable in many languages beyond those it benchmarks, and to test with the languages relevant to your use. Its Global-MMLU table gives each language as a percentage of the same model's English score; for Opus 5.5: Spanish 99.3%, French 99.3%, Arabic 99.3%, Hindi 99.2%, Swahili 98.3%, Yoruba 96.3%. The docs say to use the table to compare languages within a model, not to rank models. [https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/multilingual-support]

Anthropic's multilingual best practices: state the input and output languages explicitly, ask for 'idiomatic speech as if it were a native speaker' for fluency, submit text in its native script rather than transliteration, and consider cultural and regional context. To translate, name both languages. [https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/multilingual-support]

Google says the Gemini web app is available in more than 70 languages and over 230 countries and territories; its list includes Amharic, Arabic, French, Swahili and Zulu. [https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13575153]

Gemini image generation is available in all languages and countries where the Gemini app is available, and it can place clear text in images in many languages. [https://gemini.google/overview/image-generation/]

Claude for PowerPoint reads the deck's slide master, layouts, fonts and colour scheme and uses them when generating or editing slides; charts and diagrams it makes are editable, not static images. To build a whole deck, open a blank deck and describe your goal. [https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/powerpoint]

Claude for PowerPoint docs list Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans (not Free). The add-in is activated from Tools > Add-ins on Mac or Home > Add-ins on Windows. Persistent instructions: open Settings in the add-in sidebar and use the Instructions field. [https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/powerpoint]

Claude for PowerPoint builds slides in your templates, makes pinpoint edits to specific slides, and converts bullets into diagrams and native PowerPoint charts. [https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/powerpoint]

Claude artifact templates: Docs, Slides and Design on all plans. Claude Slides presentations can be edited slide by slide, presented inside Claude, and exported to PowerPoint or PDF, or straight to Google Slides. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17153992-what-are-artifacts-and-how-do-i-use-them]

Gamma Free includes AI creations, the AI Agent, basic image models and up to 10 slides per prompt; free credits don't refresh. Gamma Plus gives 1,500 monthly credits, removes the 'Made with Gamma' badge and allows up to 100 slides per prompt. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/8077107-how-can-i-upgrade-my-gamma-subscription]
Anthropic committed that Claude will remain ad-free, with no sponsored links. [https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-is-a-space-to-think]
